entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""I'm glad they released the governo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm glad they released the governor."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""And they did not harm anyone. Ever..."
entries.dialogueText: "And they did not harm anyone. Everything has gone incredibly well so far."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Why exactly did they release him?""
entries.dialogueText: "Why exactly did they release him?"
entries.menuText: "Why exactly did they release him?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You are saying that but your eyes..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are saying that but your eyes speak differently."
entries.menuText: "You are saying that but your eyes speak differently."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Thank you for your service, Mr. Le..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for your service, Mr. Leke."
entries.menuText: "Thank you for your service, Mr. Leke."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""Don't mention it. I did this for m..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't mention it. I did this for my people, and for Sordland."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""I haven't slept in days, Mr. Presi..."
entries.dialogueText: "I haven't slept in days, Mr. President. And of course, it was tough being around heavily armed men, if that's what you're trying to get at..."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""They said they wanted to return th..."
entries.dialogueText: "They said they wanted to return the gesture of goodwill."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""Apparently, nobody expected you to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Apparently, nobody expected you to hold talks with them."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""But they did release Mr. Bron, did..."
entries.dialogueText: "But they did release Mr. Bron, didn't they? They said they wanted to return the gesture of goodwill."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""If my service helps with the unity..."
entries.dialogueText: "If my service helps with the unity of our people, I would never hesitate to do it."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""And luckily, the meeting went well..."
entries.dialogueText: "And luckily, the meeting went well. They even released Mr. Bron, saying they wanted to return the gesture of goodwill."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""So they gave away their bargaining..."
entries.dialogueText: "So they gave away their bargaining chip just like that?"
entries.menuText: "So they gave away their bargaining chip just like that?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""And how about you?""
entries.dialogueText: "And how about you?"
entries.menuText: "And how about you?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""What did you tell them to make thi..."
entries.dialogueText: "What did you tell them to make this happen?"
entries.menuText: "What did you tell them to make this happen?"

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""To be completely honest, me neithe..."
entries.dialogueText: "To be completely honest, me neither."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""Judging by your previous actions a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Judging by your previous actions against... us."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""Yes. They don't want violence. The..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. They don't want violence. They only want their voices to be heard."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""Nothing.""
entries.dialogueText: "Nothing."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""I, and the whole delegation only r..."
entries.dialogueText: "I, and the whole delegation only relayed your intentions to find a diplomatic solution."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""As I said, they took that as a ges..."
entries.dialogueText: "As I said, they took that as a gesture of goodwill."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""What? Are you defending them now?""
entries.dialogueText: "What? Are you defending them now?"
entries.menuText: "What? Are you defending them now?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""And what were their demands?""
entries.dialogueText: "And what were their demands?"
entries.menuText: "And what were their demands?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Oh, now they are *against violence..."
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, now they are *against violence*?"
entries.menuText: "Oh, now they are *against violence*?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It's *us* now?""
entries.dialogueText: "It's *us* now?"
entries.menuText: "It's *us* now?"

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""Of course I do not support the act..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course I do not support the actions of the BFF, let alone stand with them. I only support the Bludish people."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""But you must understand they have..."
entries.dialogueText: "But you must understand they have a lot of Bludish people supporting them today."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""Because you have left them no choi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Because you have left them no choice."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""What? No.""
entries.dialogueText: "What? No."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""Of course I do not support the act..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course I do not support the actions of the BFF, nor try to defend them."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""While I do not support any of thei..."
entries.dialogueText: "While I do not support any of their actions, you must understand they have a lot of Bludish people supporting them today."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""Many in their ranks were young men..."
entries.dialogueText: "Many in their ranks were young men, probably recruited from the villages in Bergia. They are led to believe the BFF is the only way to make their voices heard."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Good. Tell me about the meeting.""
entries.dialogueText: "Good. Tell me about the meeting."
entries.menuText: "Good. Tell me about the meeting."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""First of all, they want the region..."
entries.dialogueText: "First of all, they want the region of Bergia to be made autonomous. They want the local populace to be able to govern themselves."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I should have known sending a Blud..."
entries.dialogueText: "I should have known sending a Blud was a mistake."
entries.menuText: "I should have known sending a Blud was a mistake."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Everything I've done was out of ne..."
entries.dialogueText: "Everything I've done was out of necessity."
entries.menuText: "Everything I've done was out of necessity."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""So, I'm to blame for this attack?""
entries.dialogueText: "So, I'm to blame for this attack?"
entries.menuText: "So, I'm to blame for this attack?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Just tell me about their demands.""
entries.dialogueText: "Just tell me about their demands."
entries.menuText: "Just tell me about their demands."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""Our people have suffered a lot thr..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our people have suffered a lot through the short history of this republic."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""Even though this state keeps denyi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Even though this state keeps denying it, all of us know this to be true."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""And I should have known that you m..."
entries.dialogueText: "And I should have known that you meant none of it. At your speech during the Izzam Anniversary."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""There is no excuse for oppressing..."
entries.dialogueText: "There is no excuse for oppressing a group of people, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""I'm just another *Blud* for you, a..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm just another *Blud* for you, am I not, Mr. President?"

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""You have only fed the stigma and d..."
entries.dialogueText: "You have only fed the stigma and discrimination, reinforcing this vicious cycle."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Who's reinforcing this cycle? Me o..."
entries.dialogueText: "Who's reinforcing this cycle? Me or the armed separatists who attacked our nation's energy source?"
entries.menuText: "Who's reinforcing this cycle? Me or the armed separatists who attacked our nation's energy source?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I advise you to watch your words,..."
entries.dialogueText: "I advise you to watch your words, Mr. Leke."
entries.menuText: "I advise you to watch your words, Mr. Leke."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Look. I'm doing my best to support..."
entries.dialogueText: "Look. I'm doing my best to support the Bludish people."
entries.menuText: "Look. I'm doing my best to support the Bludish people."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""I don't want to be disrespectful,..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't want to be disrespectful, Mr. President. We have an important matter to discuss here."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""I don't want these meetings to fal..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't want these meetings to fall flat. Especially not because of me. Please excuse me for my language."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""Let's try to achieve something for..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let's try to achieve something for them with this meeting then."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""I will tell you what the BFF told..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will tell you what the BFF told me."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""Let's move on to what the BFF dema..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let's move on to what the BFF demanded."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He took a deep breath."
entries.dialogueText: He took a deep breath.

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""These are their demands. They want..."
entries.dialogueText: "These are their demands. They want the governor dismissed and the Special Zone's current structure to be abolished."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He took out a piece of paper and st..."
entries.dialogueText: He took out a piece of paper and stood up.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He walked up to me and placed the p..."
entries.dialogueText: He walked up to me and placed the paper in my hands.

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""They want a local assembly to be f..."
entries.dialogueText: "They want a local assembly to be formed responsible for all regional affairs of Bergia..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He returned back to the couch and s..."
entries.dialogueText: He returned back to the couch and sat down.

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""...which is elected by the residen..."
entries.dialogueText: "...which is elected by the residents of the region."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""They also want the revocation of t..."
entries.dialogueText: "They also want the revocation of the ban on the Workers Party of Bludia and the Bludish Freedom Party..."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""They also want the revocation of t..."
entries.dialogueText: "They also want the revocation of the ban on the Bludish Freedom Party..."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""...And the revocation of both the..."
entries.dialogueText: "...And the revocation of both the Unified Education Language Act and the Religious Harmony Act..."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""And the revocation of the Unified..."
entries.dialogueText: "And the revocation of the Unified Education Language Act..."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""And the revocation of the Religiou..."
entries.dialogueText: "And the revocation of the Religious Harmony Act..."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""...as well as amnesty for every Bl..."
entries.dialogueText: "...as well as amnesty for every Bludish prisoner who was arrested for alleged separatist actions. Including Dewlen Arge."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""And here I thought we could have a..."
entries.dialogueText: "And here I thought we could have a diplomatic solution..."
entries.menuText: "And here I thought we could have a diplomatic solution..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It had been a very long time since..."
entries.dialogueText: It had been a very long time since I heard that name. He was dubbed "The Bludish Terror" by Tarquin Soll when he led the BFF against the state in 1935.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Nobody had really spoken of him sin..."
entries.dialogueText: Nobody had really spoken of him since his arrest more than 10 years ago.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'll do it. For the sake of peace.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'll do it. For the sake of peace."
entries.menuText: "I'll do it. For the sake of peace."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""There is no way I can accept such..."
entries.dialogueText: "There is no way I can accept such demands."
entries.menuText: "There is no way I can accept such demands."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""These points seem fair to me.""
entries.dialogueText: "These points seem fair to me."
entries.menuText: "These points seem fair to me."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""So, you'll initiate the attack the..."
entries.dialogueText: "So, you'll initiate the attack then? After they released the governor?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Mansoun looked at me as if he was t..."
entries.dialogueText: Mansoun looked at me as if he was trying to figure out if he understood me correctly.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Mansoun looked at me with surprise."
entries.dialogueText: Mansoun looked at me with surprise.

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""So, you'll comply with their deman..."
entries.dialogueText: "So, you'll comply with their demands then?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Yes. I'll write a decree and sign..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. I'll write a decree and sign it immediately."
entries.menuText: "Yes. I'll write a decree and sign it immediately."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Yes, but I'll need the Assembly. I..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, but I'll need the Assembly. I don't have the authority to sign such decrees anymore."
entries.menuText: "Yes, but I'll need the Assembly. I don't have the authority to sign such decrees anymore."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You heard me. I'll give them what..."
entries.dialogueText: "You heard me. I'll give them what they want."
entries.menuText: "You heard me. I'll give them what they want."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We'll put them in a bill and propo..."
entries.dialogueText: "We'll put them in a bill and propose it to the Assembly immediately."
entries.menuText: "We'll put them in a bill and propose it to the Assembly immediately."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Yes. I cannot accept these demands..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. I cannot accept these demands. And we cannot let them destroy the Soll Dam."
entries.menuText: "Yes. I cannot accept these demands. And we cannot let them destroy the Soll Dam."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""No. We'll make a counter offer.""
entries.dialogueText: "No. We'll make a counter offer."
entries.menuText: "No. We'll make a counter offer."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""Should I relay the message?""
entries.dialogueText: "Should I relay the message?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Go ahead and gather the team. I'm..."
entries.dialogueText: "Go ahead and gather the team. I'm counting on you."
entries.menuText: "Go ahead and gather the team. I'm counting on you."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""No. You've done enough. I'll have..."
entries.dialogueText: "No. You've done enough. I'll have someone else do it."
entries.menuText: "No. You've done enough. I'll have someone else do it."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""I hope they listen to you. The Ass..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hope they listen to you. The Assembly is full of anti-Bludish sentiment."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""I wouldn't think I'd regret suppor..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wouldn't think I'd regret supporting limiting presidential decrees."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He sighed."
entries.dialogueText: He sighed.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I will only accept the amnesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "I will only accept the amnesty."
entries.menuText: "I will only accept the amnesty."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I can do it except the autonomy.""
entries.dialogueText: "I can do it except the autonomy."
entries.menuText: "I can do it except the autonomy."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""First, they will have to put down..."
entries.dialogueText: "First, they will have to put down their weapons and surrender."
entries.menuText: "First, they will have to put down their weapons and surrender."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""You think they'll accept that?""
entries.dialogueText: "You think they'll accept that?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""They will if they truly desire a d..."
entries.dialogueText: "They will if they truly desire a diplomatic solution."
entries.menuText: "They will if they truly desire a diplomatic solution."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We have to try.""
entries.dialogueText: "We have to try."
entries.menuText: "We have to try."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""If they don't, I will have no othe..."
entries.dialogueText: "If they don't, I will have no other choice but to destroy them."
entries.menuText: "If they don't, I will have no other choice but to destroy them."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""This will only result in more deat..."
entries.dialogueText: "This will only result in more death and destruction in Bergia."
